segments.text: How does an iPhone recognize your face in the dark?
Up top, there's a tiny projector.
It throws more than thirty thousand invisible dots on your face.
segments.say: It throws more than thirty thousand invisible dots on your face.

segments.text: and builds a 3D map of your face.
segments.say: and builds a three D map of your face.

segments.text: Apple says the odds that a stranger unlocks it
Unless you have an evil twin.
Seriously: Apple warns that twins can fool it.
On the 18 Pro, the infrared camera even hides under the screen.
Most Android phones use the normal selfie camera:

segments.say: In a test by Which magazine,
a hundred thirty-three phones out of two hundred and eight

segments.text: were unlocked... with a printed photo.
